computerSettings.title: Computer use
computerSettings.subtitle: Let xopc use apps on your computer.
computerSettings.windowsAccessDescription: Uses your signed-in desktop. Text and keyboard input require a verified native control. Password, read-only and unsupported fields require manual input. Some background shortcuts may be refused.
computerSettings.previewFootnote: This preview can make mistakes. Check the result of each task.
computerSettings.appsBusy: A control task is active. Refresh apps later.
computerSettings.appListError: Could not read local applications. Check desktop permissions and try again.
computerSettings.desktopRequired: Open the xopc desktop app on macOS or Windows x64 to grant access. The web console cannot approve local control.
computerSettings.unsupportedPlatform: Native desktop control currently requires macOS or Windows x64.
computerSettings.modelDataUse: Window content goes to the task's model service
computerSettings.noModels: No connected compatible models. Connect OpenAI API, xopc Cloud, or a Computer Use BYOK service, then refresh the model catalog.
computerSettings.noModel: Not selected (does not inherit chat model)
computerSettings.modelUnavailable: This model cannot currently be selected. Check the connection, catalog and protocol compatibility. No automatic model switching.
computerSettings.modelSaved: New tasks will use this model
computerSettings.nativeError: Cannot read desktop status. Check the desktop application and try again.
computerSettings.preparingWindow: Preparing the app and waiting for its window…
computerSettings.preparationHint: Waits up to 5 seconds. You can stop at any time. Keyboard focus is not required.
computerSettings.inputNotStarted: No task input has been sent.
computerSettings.inputCompleted: The previous input completed. Do not repeat it.
computerSettings.inputUnknown: The previous input may have executed. Inspect the app before continuing.

errors.hidden: The target window is hidden or minimized. Show it before continuing.
errors.readyTimeout: The window did not become ready within 5 seconds. Check that the app has opened.
errors.otherSpace: The target window is on another desktop. Move it and xopc to the same desktop.
errors.capture: The window was found, but its image could not be read. Check its state before retrying.
errors.captureMismatch: The captured window does not match the selected target. Control stopped. Select the window again.
errors.backgroundUnsupported: This control does not support the requested background input. Complete this step manually.
errors.inputRefused: The app refused the input for an undetermined reason. Inspect the result before any further input.
errors.localUi: Show the xopc window before starting again. Keyboard focus is not required.
errors.windowChanged: The original window is no longer available. Select the window again.
errors.permission: The system reported unavailable desktop permissions. Check local access settings.
